title: Governance Wiring (GAWC) materialized graph
description: Schema for governance-wiring.json — the generated materialization of GAWC artifact wiring. Authored from GOVERNANCE_WIRING_PROJECTION_ARCHITECTURE.md (GWPA) §2. GENERATED ARTIFACT: emitted by scripts/verify-governance-wiring.cjs --emit from artifact frontmatter + consumption-file scan; never hand-edited (GWPA-INV-002). Edit surface = distributed frontmatter (GWPA §2 source-of-truth rule).
$comment: Two wiring families (GWPA §2.1): pact artifacts carry activation_tier (reference|routed|guarded) and a bidirectional consumed_by; matrix artifacts are wired via consumption files (required/atLeastOne) and have no tier. GWPA-INV-005: orphans/broken back-links are REPRESENTED (wiring_state) and rendered in an alarm state — never rejected by the schema or silently omitted. Enforcement of wiring is the verifier's exit code, not this schema.

generator.description: compiler id + version that emitted this file

source_of_truth.description: GWPA §2: distributed consumed_by frontmatter is canonical; this file is a generated cache

classes.description: Lane (track) definitions — one per artifact class present

columns.description: Ordered projection column axis for the pact family: the tier ladder + terminal excluded zone (GWPA §3). The matrix family is grouped by wiring_state instead.

display_order.description: stable lane order; classes do not reorder at runtime (GWPA-INV-004)

at.description: phase/section where the artifact is consumed

verified.description: true only if consumer_file actually references the artifact (bidirectional check)

id.description: stable identifier (file path, or file#ref for shared-file types), unambiguous across classes

artifact_type.description: first 6 are the types verify-governance-wiring.cjs tracks today; last 3 are GWPA target classes added as the verifier learns to track them (PIO-159), and doc-file is local to Task-Dashboard

wiring_model.description: pact = tier'd + bidirectional consumed_by (patterns, and future rolling-snapshot/protocol/collaborator-wiring); matrix = wired via consumption files (catalogs/workflows/skills/standards/invariants)

activation_tier.description: the pact column axis; required only when wiring_model == pact

declared.description: pact-only; matrix artifacts carry no declared status

wiring_state.description: derived by the compiler. orphan = in-scope with zero edges; broken-backlink = claimed consumer doesn't reference back; partial = matrix optional wiring absent

exclusion_reason.description: required when scope == excluded (e.g. append-only archive, code-verified SSOT)

consumed_by.description: may be empty for orphan/unwired artifacts — that absence IS the signal (GWPA-INV-005), not a schema error
